utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Yes, Mr. Tieger.

utterances.speaker: MR. TIEGER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. If I may be permitted a brief opportunity at some point during the day, I thought perhaps immediately after the testimony of the current witness concludes and before the next, but at whatever point the Court deems convenient, to address MFI D684.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Yes, Mr. Karadzic, please continue your cross-examination.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Good afternoon to everyone.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. Vidovic.

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Good afternoon.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: If you agree, I would like to conclude the incident of the 19th of June, which is number 8 on the F list. Can we have, again, 1D02434. While we are waiting: Mr. Vidovic, in the investigation of this incident, you did perform some kind of measurement?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: We collected the clues found on the spot. I don't remember us doing any measurements. We may have.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: If you didn't do that, was that done by someone else?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Most probably, because there were a number of us present on the site at the moment.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: We have to pause between questions and answers because we speak the same language, whatever it is called. This is a photograph that we saw yesterday. Why, then, are these measurements not contained in the report?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you please look at the photograph. Yesterday, you determined the direction of the shot towards the Vrbanja Bridge and Branimira Cosica Street, and you agreed that this tree is obstructing the view. And can you tell us, is it possible that the shot had come from Vraca or Grbavica? Is there a line of sight?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, not from this particular place. However, if you move a little bit towards here, it may have been. But I don't know if the tree was there at the time.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: If the tree wasn't there at the time, with respect to the Assembly building, where Vraca is?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Approximately somewhere behind this tree. That's my opinion, as far as I can orientate myself in the photograph.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So is Vraca at Grbavica 1; you go down the Splitska Street?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In other words, it would be more westerly over this building; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, looking at it diagonally over this tree, it would end at Vraca.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In that event, what would the trajectory of the shot be and what effect would it have on the tram? Would it come at an acute angle from the left side and to the front?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It depends where the tram was when it was hit. Since it was moving, it is not possible to determine it now.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But we did determine yesterday where the tram was, and we marked that place?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we marked one portion of the tracks where we supposed it was, because you can't see the whole intersection.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Very well. Would you prefer to look at it on a map? Can we please have now the map, and I'll give you a number shortly. That's the one that we saw yesterday. It's D787. It already contains a number of markings that would be helpful for you to clarify this. Do you agree, Mr. Vidovic, that Vraca is somewhere due south from the letter G, where it says "Grbavica," and the shopping mall?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Roughly speaking, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you please put an arrow to mark this, and put the letter V?

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: The interpreters are not sure which letter the accused said.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You can use a red pencil.

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]. Roughly speaking.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So Vraca is in the continuation of this arrow. Can you please now draw a line, a straight line, to the place where the incident took place?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you please put the number 5 next to it?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And put the number 6 next to the arrow that indicates the location of Vraca.

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree, Mr. Vidovic, that in this case the shot would have come at an acute angle of approximately 35 degrees at the front and from the left?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Approximately, yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we have this admitted into evidence?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But did you mention any other possibility? Do you agree that this trajectory would have crossed above all these buildings, even the Executive Council building which is a high-rise building?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, now, judging by this map, I cannot tell you anything about that. If we had had a photograph taken from Vraca, perhaps. But as it is --

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we have this admitted into evidence as a separate exhibit?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Let us do it again. Could you put the date and signature again, kindly, Mr. Vidovic? 20th of October.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Use the same colour, the colour black.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. That will be admitted.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit D789, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now have 65 ter 09542.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we agree, Mr. Vidovic, that through one point, an infinite number of lines can pass, whereas only one line can connect two dots?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I didn't understand you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: How many straight lines can pass through one point or one spot?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Indefinite number.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now, how many straight lines can connect two dots?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: One.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: That's correct. Did you have two benchmarks in the tram, in the form of the bullet traces?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: As far as I remember with it, one was on the metal sheet and the other one was on the seat opposite.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree that if you connect these two dots and if you extend this line, you could arrive approximately at the point of the origin of fire?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I'm afraid I didn't give you the correct number. 09542. That's not the number. That should be a photograph, and then we'll move to page 14.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: This has been admitted as Exhibit P1758, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I was hoping that we have this in colour and more light. We first need the photograph on the left, and it has to be turned around.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you tell us what this photograph represents?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can't see anything. I suppose that these white lines are the tram windows, but other than that --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But how did the investigation team mark this photograph?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I suppose that on the basis of what is written underneath, that this is a photograph of the tram.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you read what it says underneath?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "General view of the tram hit by a bullet fired from," it's not very clear, "Grbavica-Vraca. The arrow indicates the point of impact of the bullet."

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Are you familiar with this photograph?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: As I already said, it's very unclear. I can only assume that this is one of the photographs taken during the investigation.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Who took these photographs?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think I did.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second. Is the picture we are seeing on the English page the same picture?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I hope that in English, it's better. And if we have the appropriate page in English, can we look at it?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: However, I'm not sure whether this is this identical picture.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, that's a different picture. We're going to call it up later.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: It looks like page 10 in English, but it does not help either. Mr. Gaynor, do you have an original colour picture of these?

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: We're trying to look into that right now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You are right, it's page 10 in English, but it's still not good.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Let us move on, Mr. Karadzic. In the meantime, we'll try to get a proper picture, if possible.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we look now at the next page, page 17, so that we can just have a quick look at the photograph that we saw a minute ago. Page 17.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is this the point of impact of a 7.62 bullet at the support of the seat?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's what it says, but everything is black. I can't discern anything.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But you will remember that these two traces of the bullet were found and that it was possible, with a certain degree of precision, to determine the direction, which was indicated in the photograph as Branimira Cosica Street. Do you agree that nothing established and determined here was beyond reasonable doubt?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't understand you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In this particular event, was it established beyond any doubt who fired the shot and from where it came?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: We established the direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And you marked it?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we did.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we perhaps request that other photographs be obtained for the proceedings, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I have no doubt that Mr. Gaynor will look into the matter.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. 65 ter 10496 contains a set of eight photographs which were marked by this witness in court during his testimony in the Galic trial, which may assist on this point.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Shall we try.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Perhaps we need to turn it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is this the right position, Mr. Vidovic?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think so. Yes, that should be the correct position.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree that this is quite a regular circle that the bullet made in the metal?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, from what we can see on the photograph.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So, then, the direction that you marked accords with this one. The bullet would leave such a trace in the metal if its impact is at a right angle; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we look at the photograph from page 14 now, the one that we saw before this one, or from page 318 - these are the last ERN digits - so that we can see the seat. I think this is page 7 of this document with that ERN number, page 7.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Of this document; yes?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: It's upside down. Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is this the second trace of the bullet impact, the one that struck the seat support?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. So we have two directions. One is along the horizontal line; the other is along the vertical line. Along the horizontal line, it came the way you marked it in blue. Along the vertical line, could you indicate the height of these traces, Mr. Vidovic, in relation to the floor?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can just make an assumption here. I don't know when the measurements were taken and what the measurements were, but on this seat I would say that --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could you wait a minute. We have to turn the photo again. And could you wait until the usher assists you. Do you like the witness to mark something on the photo?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I would like to tender these two photographs, but I would like to establish the height on the metal and the height on the seat, which will make it possible then to look at the angle along the vertical line. Along the horizontal line, we established that the bullet arrived at a right angle. The witness confirmed that. Now we're talking about the vertical line. Perhaps Mr. Vidovic could use the report in order to get some help on this. If this is something that is mentioned in the report, then we will use that.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Well, if the measurements are written there, then all right. But, approximately, we can see that it's some 30 to 40 centimetres high from the floor of the tram.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: This is underneath the seat. This is the support, and you can just see a little part of the seat?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct, you can only see a small part of the seat.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So if we knew the height of the bullet on the support, then we could tell whether it was coming from above to below or from below up, and then we can establish the angle. Was this established in this case?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. As far as I can remember, this is not mentioned in my report.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And can you look at the impact of the bullet, the dent? Does that indicate that the friction at the lower edge was a bit deeper and that the bullet came from below? The upper edge is more steep, so the bullet came from the bottom and impacted more along the bottom, the lower edge of the indent; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, that doesn't have to indicate anything in this case, because on the other side it passed through the metal. So you cannot really establish the rest of the trajectory. It ricochetted from the metal when it came in.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So that means that if it was ricochetted higher, its point of impact on the metal was probably lower, and if this had changed once it had gone through the metal, then it probably impacted the metal lower, at its entrance point?

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Could the witness please repeat his answer.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Vidovic --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: The witness and the accused are kindly asked to pause between question and answer. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: It's easy to forget that because what you are answering should be translated into English, so it's important for you, both of you, to put a pause between the question and answer, and slow down. The last of your answer was not translated, so if you could kindly repeat your answer, Mr. Vidovic.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Well, it's like this: I said that the bullet entered at the level of the heating grill of the tram, which in this photograph is marked with a blue circle, and it's located on the opposite side from the seat. So according to what is here, the bullet came, and here it already lost some of its height when it hit the seat.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Was this bullet found?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was found at the bottom part of the photograph. You can see a part of the number that was used to mark the bullet.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you please mark that with an arrow, because I am not able to see that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Before you mark it --

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Actually, perhaps it can be seen on the following photograph. Can we admit this, and then can we move to the next photograph, because that's -- it's better -- we will be able to see better on the next photograph.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: If necessary, and I'm not opposed to -- we can admit the whole set of this document, eight pictures. Are they already in evidence?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: They are in evidence as Exhibit P1759, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] In this case; is that correct? All right. I don't know that it was shown before, but I didn't propose it for admission deliberately again. Can we look at the following photograph. Can we turn it around.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And this is where the number 1 marks the place where the bullet was found?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What kind of a bullet is it?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: According to my report, it's a 7.62-calibre shell casing.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Mr. Vidovic, did you choose between the option that it was a deliberate strike on the tram or just an accidental strike? Did you express an opinion about that?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So is it possible that it could have been either deliberate or accidental; both options are possible? Is that possible?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: When you ask me in that way, then, yes, it can be either deliberate or accidental.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Very well. And do you agree that sniper ammunition in our area uses different types of calibre in both armies, both the Bosnian Army and the JNA?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: In the JNA, the calibre was 7.9 millimetres, but I really don't know who used what at that time. There were all sorts of weapons.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Who drafted the final report? Who signed the final report?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I really don't remember. It's probably one of my colleagues from the Criminal Investigation Unit, but I don't remember all of those who took part in the investigation.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And how was it that they said that the bullet disintegrated or was fragmented, and we can see here that there is a bullet?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: You can see fragments of a bullet here.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: All right, Mr. Vidovic, thank you very much. Were these fragments large enough in order to be able to establish the calibre?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, ballistics experts can establish the calibre on the basis of those fragments. I mean, they were probably of a sufficient size, since the calibre was established.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Who was the ballistics expert in the team?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I really don't remember. I think it was Boro Stankov. I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Now I would like you to focus on a different incident in the investigation of which you also took part. We can put the photograph away now. Do you recall the incident that occurred on the 14th of February, 1995, at 1722 hours, the tram, tram number 212; do you recall that?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: If you could show me some photographs, if you have any, that would help, but I think that I do remember.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we look at 10510, please. This is a 65 ter number, 10510. This is the cover page of the set of photographs that bears your signature. That is bound to remind you of the incident.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: This is Exhibit P1748, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we look at page 8, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is it easier for you to remember this now?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I think I know what this is about.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. You were a criminal investigations technician at the on-site investigation, and you signed this set of photographs; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we look at page 6.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now, in this report from the on-scene investigation, you said that the damage was 18 times 15 millimetres on the glass of the window behind the driver; is that correct? Do you remember if that was the fifth window, counting backwards from the driver?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's what it says in the report.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you remember that this entry location of the bullet was 16 centimetres from the floor of the tram; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's what it says in the report.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Sixty-one centimetres from the left-hand glass?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And nine centimetres from the lower edge of the window?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So do you agree that now we have some elements in order to set up a kind of triangle which would include all of these elements that you have just referred to?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And can we now look at page 13 of this document.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: We will show you the photograph later, but would you agree that it says here that the injured passenger, Buljubasic, was sitting on the third double seat going back from the driver on the right-hand side? Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. I didn't see whether it says the right-hand side. Actually, according to this, it's the left side.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we bring back the previous page we were looking at, page 6, so that we can look at the text in the Serbian, so that Mr. Vidovic can check again the location.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] He was sitting on the right-hand chair.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Which row from the driver?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Third double row -- double seat back from the driver.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we now look at page 13, where there is a photograph. We actually looked at it just a little bit earlier.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is this the photo that you made for the purposes of this investigation report?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And it shows, what, the place where the bullet entered?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, and it's marked with number 1, as you can also see, because there's a point indicating that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. So this is nine centimetres from the edge of the window, from the lower edge; correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I assume so, according to the report, although you can't really see it here in this photo. You can't see the hole where the bullet came in; not on this photo, in any case.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But I'm sure that, as in the previous case, there must be photographs that are somewhat easier to look at. Now, would you agree with me that the seat, the seat -- the back of the seat, is actually higher than the edge of the window?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, if we looked from this perspective, and judging by this arrow, I wouldn't really think so.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, but if we were to look at this from a right angle, from the perpendicular perspective, it would be even clearer, whereas from here we see it from the bird's-eye view, and you can still see that it's a bit higher than the window edge?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, no, I wouldn't agree with that.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Well, then I would really appreciate getting a better photo.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Do we have them, Mr. Gaynor?

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: I don't believe we have better photos of this, Mr. President. We'll certainly look into the matter and submit them if we find them.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we then have 1D2614. 1D2614.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree that this photo was taken from the upper --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: The interpreter did not understand the last word.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Do you mean from up higher?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, you're a photographer. You should know what "recourse" means.

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, no, I don't.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, here it is. Now we can see it better.

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, again, this is not very clear.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Karadzic, the last set of questions and answers were not properly translated.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, as for the angle under which this photo was taken, this photograph was not taken either from a horizontal perspective or from below. It was actually taken from a slightly higher position; for instance, from a standing position. Correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And from that standing position, one can see that the edge of the window -- of the seat -- of the back of the seat is actually higher than the edge of the window; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, no, I don't really see that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Very well. Tell us, then, is the entry point of this bullet properly marked?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I'm sure it is. But, again, I have to say that based on this photo, I can't really determine that because there is so many of these little dots that I really can't discern which one it is.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But would you agree that from the edge of the window to the entry point, the -- according to your measurements, the distance was nine centimetres?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. However, I don't know what you mean by -- in other words, in this photograph, the lower yellow or golden arrow point, that is the lower edge, and then there is a portion of rubber there, and then only begins the window-pane.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But how did you do the measurements? Where did you begin?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, from the rubber edge.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, maybe we can have a better photo. Now, did you actually mark this?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, as far as I can recall, it wasn't me.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Was there any kind of trace on the back of the seat, a bullet trace?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I don't recall that. I believe not.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In other words, the bullet impacted the window at a height of 86 centimetres from the ground; correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And then if we were to take off these nine centimetres from those eighty-six, what, then, would be the height of the window edge?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Seventy-three.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, I would say 77.

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I'm sorry, 77.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But you can see that the back of the seat is some 80 centimetres from the floor. Did you measure that?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know how high the tip of the seat of -- of the back of the seat is from the floor.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, do you consider that important in view of the fact that you measured the height of the edge of the window and there is another object here that can serve as -- to measure, and how come did you not measure that?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, probably because there was not any damage on it, so that's probably why we didn't measure the height of that item.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In that event, that would mean that the bullet had the trajectory between the seat -- the back of the seat and the point that you marked here; correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't think I understand your question. Based on what we can see here, the bullet actually -- its path was above the seat.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well, thank you. I would like to tender this photograph.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I don't think we can admit this. This is a picture marked by the Defence team, and the witness did not confirm as to the gap between the edge of the table and the window. So you'll have another opportunity to tender this.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Let us now establish the following: The place where the wounded person was, were there any traces, bullet traces, on the back of the seat where the wounded was sitting?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I think I've already said that. If you mean whether the seat was grazed or in any other way there was a defect, no.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But he wasn't sitting at this seat; right? He was sitting -- this window is actually in line with the fifth seat from behind the driver, whereas he was sitting at the third seat behind the driver; correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: The interpreter did not hear the question.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [No interpretation]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Karadzic, the interpreters couldn't hear your last question.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Did the wounded person sit in the seat that we can see here in this photo? Was he sitting there?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Or was this a different seat?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the seat closer to us, the seat in close-up, as it were, in the foreground. That's where he was sitting.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In the foreground?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now, where was Buljubasic wounded, what part of the body?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know, but I think that it's noted in the report exactly. I did not have enough time to read it through a moment ago.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree, then, that the wound was somewhere about 80 centimetres from the floor?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I really can't say that. I was not on the site when it happened, so the wounded --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's correction: The wounded person was not there, so I wouldn't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, we have this information. Eighty-six centimetres from the floor there is a bullet hole in the window-pane, so that's eighty-six centimetres from the floor of the tram and nine centimetres up the edge of the window. Where, then, is the second point that can help us determine the angle of incidence of this bullet?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, on the body of the wounded person.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: At what height?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is it still your position that the wounded person was wounded in some part of the body that is above the seat, the back of the seat?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I assume so, but these -- especially because these backs of the seats are not very tall, and a person of a normal height would -- it would go halfway up their back.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we now have the photo on page 14.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Page 14 of what; the previous exhibit, P1748?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Of this exhibit, yes. 274 are the last three digits. 10510, and then page 14 of that document. I believe that's the same number as the previous photo.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is this a photo that you made as well?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: From the point of impact on the window-pane to the point where the entry wound was on the body of the wounded person, is it your claim that the place where the wounded person was sitting was parallel to this window; correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But if he was sitting in the third row behind the driver, then there is a difference of some seven rows, or, rather, a difference of some 4.2 metres to 5 metres. So would you agree with me that this was the fifth window-pane and the third row from behind the driver, which would indicate that there was a shift in the -- or, rather, that there was a trajectory -- that the bullet travelled some four to five metres through the tram; correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I don't really know. It's not quite clear.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: The fifth window-pane in the tram is in line with the tenth row of seats, and the wounded person sat or was sitting in the third row, so there are seven rows in between. In other words, the fifth window-pane -- each window-pane is in line with two rows, so that the fifth window-pane is actually in line with the tenth row of the seats, so the wounded person was actually sitting in the first half of the third -- of the second window-pane?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I really don't know that.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could the Prosecutor please provide a hard copy of this on-site investigation report so that the witness can look at the screen and at the same time be able to refresh his memory?

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Yes, I do -- I do have a hard copy of that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: If it can be provided to the witness.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could we get a copy too, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I'm not sure it's for the Prosecution to provide a print-out of the exhibit which is in the e-court. I think you've been provided with this exhibit a long time ago. But I think, if necessary, the Registry may help you by printing it out, on an exceptional basis.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we have P1759, the sixth photograph. Your Excellency, I agree with you, but the e-court materials that we have received are useless. As you can see, we cannot really see anything on them. Witness, please use the hard copy. You're free to do that. So could we have, please, P1759, that photo.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I take it that what the Prosecution has is identical to what you have. Is that not the case, Mr. Gaynor?

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Yes, that is the case, and these are, after all, exhibits from the witness's previous evidence, so simply taken from that trial and provided to Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you please look at this photograph. How many rows of seats can you see if you look at one window-pane?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Two, according to this photo and this window-pane, because this first seat is a single seat and the one before it is a double seat.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. So the fifth window-pane is the window-pane through which the bullet -- where the bullet impacted; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, according to the report.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So the fifth window-pane would actually be in line with the ninth and tenth rows of seats; correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I can't really say off the top of my head. But based on the calculation and the numbers, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now, the third row of seats on the right-hand side of the tram is far forward of the spot where the bullet impacted the tram; correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Well, again, judging by -- or proceeding from your calculations, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Would you agree, then, that at that distance of some 4.2 to 4.9 metres, the angle of fall or the angle of incidence was less than 1 degree?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, not quite.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, what would the angle be, then?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I really couldn't tell you accurately.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, let me remind you. The entry point at the window is above the seat, and it is nine centimetres up of the edge of the seat. The place where Mr. Buljubasic was wounded was above the tip of the back of the seat, because there is no bullet trace on the seat. So would you agree with me that the trajectory of this bullet was almost horizontal?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, if you look at it that way, yes. But I still cannot tell you exactly where the seat was, not judging by this photograph, because there is also some room behind the driver before the first row of seats. And how many windows exactly there are, I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: We are not concerned about the rear end. From the point of entry of the bullet, there are five windows, and the fifth window was hit?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So the bullet was travelling between the tenth row and the third row, covering seven rows before it hit Mr. Buljubasic sitting in the third row behind the driver; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now, the entry point of the bullet is above the lower edge of the window and above the seat, and Mr. Buljubasic was hit in the back, above the top end of the back of the seat?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second. We didn't hear the answer of the witness.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we have, again, the photograph 10510, page 14.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: We have enlarged your photograph a bit. Do you agree that this circle indicates that the bullet entered through the window, through the glass, at an acute angle?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I couldn't be able to say that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can I be of help? Are the radiuses equal or is one longer?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know what I can tell you on the basis of this.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Tell me, the diametre of this hole, the horizontal one, is it longer than the vertical one?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Judging by this photocopy, I wouldn't say so.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But this is a photograph you made. Does the pattern of the shattering of the glass indicate that this was an acute angle rather than a right angle? Does it indicate that the bullet entered at an angle, in fact?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, not to me.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Are you trying to say that the bullet entered at the angle of 90 degrees?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Probably not 90 degrees, but --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you please use the red pen to mark coordinates on this photograph, i.e., the horizontal axis and the vertical axis of the bullet hole?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Gaynor.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: I believe the witness's previous answer was not fully interpreted. He did continue to speak while Mr. Karadzic asked the next question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. All we heard, Mr. Vidovic, is: "Probably not 90 degrees, but --" The interpretation stopped there. Could you repeat your answer, please?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Maybe it would be helpful if I repeat my questions.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Are you trying to say this bullet entered through the window at a 90-degree angle?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. It is possible, everything is possible. But based on this photocopy of the photograph, I can't say anything definitely.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But can you rely on your investigation reports that you have with you?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm looking at it, but there's no angle mentioned here because I didn't do the ballistic expert analysis.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you please take a red pencil and draw coordinates, an X-axis and a Y axis? And then after, that we shall see whether there's a difference between the length of the two.

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Mr. Vidovic, you didn't put it exactly in the center, as you should.

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, it's difficult for me.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: I think that everybody can see that the horizontal one is longer. If they were to intersect at the center, it would be obvious that the horizontal one was longer?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, to me they seem identical, but it is possible that the horizontal axis is the longer one.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you please put the date and your initials on this photograph?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Mr. President, the entire exercise seems to be a complete waste of time. It's entirely up to Your Honours' discretion, obviously.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: This is not a scheduled incident.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: That's correct, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MORRISON
utterances.text: Dr. Karadzic, whether it's a scheduled incident or not, I'm amused at what conceivable use this exercise has been. I've been waiting to see whether or not there was something that I was failing to spot, but I don't think there is.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Well, this is how it's going to be useful: It's an incident that was included by the Prosecution through this witness, although it's not contained in the indictment. They had a valid reason to do that, because they wanted to demonstrate that there was a pattern. We wanted to take this example to prove that everything was different. Regardless of the fact that it's not in the indictment, the Chamber will gain certain impressions from this. Now, let's expedite matters. Can this photograph be admitted into evidence? And after that, I would like to call up 1D2615.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: What the Chamber wanted to tell you is that, Mr. Karadzic, you can argue that horizontal line is longer than the vertical line without asking the witness to draw this -- have this unhelpful cross on this photo, which is not helpful at all. So this is a waste of time.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] All right. Can it be admitted?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit D790, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we now have 1D2615.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Please, Mr. Vidovic, look at this photograph, the number of windows and the number of seats. And can you approximately mark where the third row was? 1D2615. Do you see where the driver is?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Before you do that: Mr. Vidovic, is this the same tram that was used at the time?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, it isn't.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is it considerably different? Are all the trams of approximately the same size?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. As far as I know, every tram is different. It depends on the manufacturer, it depends on the model. I even don't know where this tram was photographed. Not at Sarajevo, definitely.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But on the previous photograph, we see that there are two rows of windows -- two rows of seats next to one window?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, in this section of the tram.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: All we are interested in now is the distance between the driver and the third row of seats, and the distance between the third and the tenth rows, where the bullet entered. Can you mark these distances on this photograph?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I won't allow it unless it is suggested that the tram is of a similar kind to the one that was used at the time. I recommend you to move on.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Excellency, I have to ask the witness to show us the trajectory of the bullet from the point of entry until the point of wounding the witness. We cannot do otherwise. The material is insufficient. We tried to establish that the bullet entered through the fifth window and hit the man in the third row which is next to --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: You can make a submission to that effect when you make a final submission, but this witness is not able to confirm what you are saying at this moment. So I suggest having a break now for 25 minutes, after which you will have half an hour to conclude your cross-examination, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I can't make it in half an hour. We have a witness here who conducted investigations. Who am I going to clarify these matters with, other than him?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: The Chamber gave you two hours, and we made it clear that your time would be limited to two hours. And I emphasised several times that you have to prioritise your questioning, and as indicated by the Chamber, you wasted a lot of time. We'll take a break, and think about your planning again. Twenty-five minutes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I have to say that the OTP had a very good reason to introduce a number of incidents through this witness that are not covered by the indictment. Why? Because they cannot build their case on individual incidents, so they are attempting to establish a pattern. And I can only be grateful to them for introducing these incidents, because if I am given more than 20 minutes per incident, I can show that there is a pattern of behaviour by the Muslim side in order to blame us. They were playing games with angles and with cardinal directions. And if I don't have more than 20 minutes per incident, that in every other country would be subject to three or four days in court, I don't have a proper opportunity to defend myself. The OTP had their reasons, their valid reasons, for introducing these materials. Therefore, I'm asking for your understanding. I may do it more quickly. This witness conducted investigations, and I can demonstrate that the angles will prove that the shots could not have come from the Serbian side, and this witness can confirm that because he was the one who made the sketches and who investigated this. I cannot bring any other witness of that calibre. Therefore, I understand that this is your policy, but I am kindly asking for your understanding. That's the only way that I can defend myself and I can defend the Serbian cause, because I know that there was not a single civilian target subjected to sniping or shelling.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: What the Chamber wanted to tell you, Mr. Karadzic, was that when a witness is not able to answer all your questions to the effect you want, you don't have to put every point of your case to the witness. Just put your case, and then you can move on to other topics. But you are trying to put every point to every witness, which the Court finds unhelpful. So how many more minutes would you need to conclude your cross-examination for this witness?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] With this incident, I'm going to finish quickly because the witness cannot provide any more answers, so I have three more incidents in total. Therefore, I would need at least an hour for the witness to demonstrate what he participated in. Six incidents have been introduced through this witness. One of them is in the indictment, and the remaining five serve the purpose of establishing that there was a pattern of behaviour pursued by the Serbian side.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Were there not two scheduled incidents? I should stand corrected if I'm wrong.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Actually, Mr. President, I made the same mistake. There's one incident of shelling on the 16th of June that I thought was also scheduled, because there's two scheduled incidents on that date, but apparently this is not -- this is a third incident that's not scheduled. So there's only one scheduled incident.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. You will have an hour, Mr. Karadzic. Let's bring in the witness.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: While we have that picture in front of us, is it not a Dutch tram, Mr. Karadzic?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, but the ratio is the same, except for the window being lower. Since I am not proving here the vertical angle, but the horizontal angle, then this could be used as an example, because two rows of seats are covered by one window.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I take it to be the number 17. Yes, Mr. Gaynor.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Yes. I probably don't need to say this, but there's absolutely no evidence on the record to show that this specific model -- the dimensions of this model have anything in common with the dimensions of the trams in Sarajevo during the conflict.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: While we are waiting for the witness, shall I give a -- shall I issue an oral ruling in relation to Witness 166? Oh, he's coming. We'll do that during the interval [Realtime transcript read in error "in turn"].

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I said we'll do that during the interval. Yes, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Mr. Vidovic, we are going to finish with this incident quickly. Can we look at 1D2618, please. And while we're waiting: Mr. Vidovic, the main thing that I would like to establish here in this incident is whether you've seen in your report -- or said in your report that the bullet entered at the fifth window and hit the man in the back who was sitting in the third row.

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We've taken this particular tram because of the distribution of the rows, not because of the height of the windows.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We made it clear. Move on to your next topic. This is of no help at all.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In this case, did you make the determination that this came from the Serbian side?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Only that we established the direction that it came from.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In order to establish the direction, is it important to know the angle?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: In this case, we did not take the angle into account; only the entrance damage to the tram.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: How were you able to set the two points on the basis of which you could determine the direction? On the basis of which did you determine -- what did you determine where the tram came from?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Only on the basis of the damage that we found on the tram.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we look at 1D2619, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So this vertex height of the triangle, is that the place where the tram was hit?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I assume so. That's how it should be.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: I would like you to mark that place, please. And if you could make an arrow, and mark the arrow with the number 1.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: It is there. I don't see any need to ask the witness to mark on the map. Put your question, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you know where the line of separation is here on the left bank of the Miljacka River?

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You see the street of Hamdija Cemerlic. That is the street where --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: That question was asked yesterday. Just put your question in relation to this document.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Mr. Vidovic, if this angle were greater or smaller, where would the fire come from?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I really don't understand. We generally have the direction. On the basis of the report, we establish the direction where the bullet came from. As for the angle or the height, we have the side where the bullet came from, but I cannot speak about the height.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And did your investigation team establish that it's approximately 18 degrees? You can look at it in the report.

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That is not stated in my report.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Are you able to draw the direction here?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could you wait a minute. Yes, Mr. Gaynor.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Mr. President, I'm concerned that the record is going to become very confused, because the location of the tram, the angle of 17.63 degrees, the point marked "Hypothetical point of firing," have all been placed there by a member of the Defence team for Mr. Karadzic for the purposes of these proceedings, I assume. And if the witness is now going to mark that, the record is going to become confusing.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We have a clean copy of this map, without these markings, which is --

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We do. This is 2581, 2581.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. Why don't we bring that up.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 1D2581.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. Could you mark the place where the tram was hit, and circle it, and put number 1 there.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: And for you, Mr. Karadzic, to continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Mr. Vidovic, could you be a little bit more precise? This would be an area of 100 or 200 metres, wouldn't it? We need to be more precise in relation to the incident location.

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, since the tram was moving, it's not possible to be precise.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: How can we then be precise and say that the bullet came from the Serbian side?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: As I said, in my report, all it states is the direction where the fire came from.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you indicate that direction on the map, please?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, it would be approximately like this [marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And now can you look at the base of the triangle. That would be the route of the tram. So could you indicate, with one line, the possible direction that the shot came from? Since the tram has its own route, that would form the base of the triangle?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, it would be something like this [marks]. So more or less, that would be this direction here [indicating].

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And how many possible entry angles would you have here; from close to 90 to how much?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I really don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And who is controlling the territory that lies at where the base of the triangle lies?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't understand what the base of the triangle is.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, this part that lies along the Miljacka River. From which high-rise buildings could the shot have been fired from?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, these buildings here in the area called "Shopping."

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And who controlled the area of "Shopping"?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The Serbian side.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you please mark that?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And these high-rise buildings in the "Shopping," the angle would have to be 90 degrees, would it not?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, it would not.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you please shade the area where the possible fire could have come from, and can you indicate the approximate angle?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm sorry, I don't really understand what it is exactly that I'm supposed to do. Shade what?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You have two sides of the triangle here, and the third would be the line of the base of the triangle, and this is how you indicated the area where the tram could possibly have been hit if the fire came from the direction that you indicated. So can you shade that as the field of the possible trajectory?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Are we talking about the circle here or the triangle?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: The triangle.

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: All right, then it's like this [marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. And now can you please tell us, did the bullet come from the front or did it come from the back to the front?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, you know it entered at the fifth window and hit the third row of seats?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. But, again, we didn't establish what the tram looks like from the inside, so I'm not able to tell you anything about it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Vidovic, I have difficulty understanding the meaning of the shaded part. Could you tell us what your understanding is as to that shaded part?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Well, actually, to tell you the truth, I'm not quite clear what it indicates either. I just did what Mr. Karadzic asked me to do.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Let me be clear about this. You said what you established at the time is the direction of fire, not the potential possible origin of the fire?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: And you indicated that direction you established at the time with an arrow --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: -- which we see on the left side. Then the line on the right side does not match with the direction you established at the time. Am I correct in so understanding?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You mean this other line? Yes. Mr. Karadzic asked me to draw the triangle, where the apex would be here [indicates], so I just drew an approximate triangle and indicated the possible -- the direction the bullet was coming from that hit the tram with an arrow. And the tram was moving in this area that I indicated with the number 1.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I take it that Mr. Karadzic asked you to draw that line on the assumption that the fire was originating from the shopping area -- high-rise building in the shopping area. Was that the fact that you established at the time?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Let me say it again. We did not establish exactly the place from where the bullet was fired. We just established the direction from where it came, and we indicated that with the arrow, and that was from the direction of the south-east.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Karadzic, please continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: May I be of assistance. Mr. Vidovic, I asked you to say at which section of the rail could the tram have been hit, and I wanted to see how it was that you established that the base of the triangle was at the shopping city area, because the base of the triangle should be the section of the rail where the tram should have been hit. This is very important for us to be able to establish where the fire came from, once we establish where the tram actually was. Without that, we don't have the angle. And I'm saying that we cannot have an angle that is greater than 13.4. What do you say to that?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Again, I say we just established the direction from where the bullet came, and not the precise place from which it was fired.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: The bullet came from the south; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: According to this, from the south-south-east.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Could it have come from someplace that was not under the control of the Serbs? Did you indicate which side fired?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. And this base of the triangle, which should be in this circle, the base indicating where the tram could have been hit from point A to point B, would that help to establish the direction, that position plus the angle? Could that be used to establish the angle?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, we could indicate that by drawing it on the map on the basis of the drawing.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Did anyone know the precise place where the tram was hit? Can you read in your report exactly the position of the tram? Opposite from which building was it located when it was hit?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: All it says is that the tram was moving along the Zmaja od Bosne Street.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And where was it hit?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The bullet entered through the fifth window from the driver down.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And what was the location of the tram?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It doesn't say that. All it says is "Zmaja od Bosne Street." Let me just look.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, Zmaja od Bosne Street is several kilometres long?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] May I just ask for your indulgence for a few minutes, please. I just wanted to look at the map of the lines.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we -- please, sir, can you put your signature and the date on the map so that we can tender it?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Gaynor.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Mr. President, the witness has already testified that he, himself -- quite properly, he's pointed out that he, himself, is not quite sure what the shaded area means. I don't see any utility --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We have that part in our transcript, but that arrow has some meaning, doesn't it; direction of fire which the witness established at the time, the left --

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Yes, I can see that, but --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So can you not admit it --

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Very well, for that specific --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: -- under that understanding?

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Very well, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, that will be admitted.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit D790.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could you put the date and the signature?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: In order to be clear, change the colour into black and draw the line again, the direction that you established at the time.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Could we then have map 09390C. That's the 65 ter number.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: And sheet number?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 11. That's number 9. Could we have sheet 11. Two maps after this one.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Two pages further, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you recognise the area in this plan? Could we please zoom in on the upper left portion of the map. Can you recognise what's depicted here?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you please mark on this map the point where the tram was struck and also the place which you indicated as the direction from which the bullet came? Please go ahead. I don't want to suggest any markings to you.

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, this is approximately the stretch of the tracks [marks], and this would be the direction [marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Would you agree with me that the angle of incidence would approximate 90 degrees?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I can't really tell.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, tell us, what would it be, at minimum?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, we don't have the angle of incidence.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: However, what you've indicated here, and in relation to the tram tracks, this looks like an angle of approximately anywhere between 70 and 110 degrees. If it came from the front, then it would be a 70-degree, an acute angle, and if it came from the back, it would be 110, an obtuse angle; correct?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, approximately.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. And we are trying to prove here that it could not be greater than 13 because the bullet entered the window-pane on the fifth window-pane and it hit the person who was sitting next to the third window-pane.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Do not argue with the witness. The witness has answered your question, and move on. You can make your submission later.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Will you please sign and date this?

utterances.speaker: BOGDAN VIDOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second. By mistake, I was advised that the Chamber or the Court Deputy has lost the previous marked map. But we don't have to restore it. Instead, we'll keep this one. So we'll give the exhibit number to this one. Is it okay? Then we'll give the number for this.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: This is Exhibit D791.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Well, if we need that map, we can actually recover it later on.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. In order to understand -- to follow the proceedings, we may need to recover it. That can be done by using the video. So we'll give the number for that, a separate number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this particular map will be Exhibit D792, and the previous one will be Exhibit D791.
